import os,json,subprocess,socket,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'/srv/projects/skill-universal/current')
from engine import tool_runtime
adb=tool_runtime.executable('adb')
out={'task':'original Ferrari private ADB availability','catalog_binary_available':bool(adb),'devices':[]}
if adb:
 env=os.environ.copy();env['ANDROID_USER_HOME']='/srv/projects/skill-universal/.runtime/android-cli/home/.android'
 try:
  with socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',5037),timeout=0.5):existed=True
 except OSError:existed=False
 try:
  p=subprocess.run([adb,'devices','-l'],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)

   parts=line.split()

 finally:
  if not existed:
   subprocess.run([adb,'kill-server'],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=8)
   out['temporary_adb_server_stopped']=True
print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True),flush=True)
